description: This file defines a SettingsController class for managing user profile settings such as streaming quality and default subtitles. It uses a cache service to persist settings and notifies listeners on updates.

classes.name: SettingsController
classes.description: A controller class that manages user profile settings like streaming quality and subtitles, using a cache for persistence and change notifications for updates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads settings from cache, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setQuality
methods.description: Sets the streaming quality, updates cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSubtitlesDefault
methods.description: Sets whether subtitles are enabled by default, updates cache, and notifies listeners.
